VAKRA：评估跨 API 的多跳推理和工具使用策略下的检索VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies

Ankita Rajaram Naik    Anupama Murthi    Benjamin Elder    Siyu Huo Affiliation: Raavi Gupta, Abhinav Jain, Praveen Venkateswaran, Abdulhamid Adebayo, Affiliation: Danish Contractor Affiliation: IBM, Yorktown Heights, NY, USA Affiliation: Correspondence:ankita.naik@ibm.com, anupama.murthi@ibm.com
摘要Abstract

部署在企业环境中的代理必须跨结构化 API 和文档集合进行推理，但现有基准测试是孤立评估这些功能的。我们介绍 VAKRA（eAgents deployed in enterprise settings must reason across structured APIs and document collections, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. We introduce VAKRA (eV评估aluatingAPI 和PI andK知识nowledgeR永恒的etrievalA先生们）gents)11 1 这个名字也暗指梵文The name also alludes to the Sanskrit婆克拉vakra，意味着弯曲或间接，唤起智能体必须导航的非线性推理路径。, meaning curved or indirect, evoking the non-linear reasoning paths agents must navigate.，超过的基准, a benchmark of over8,0008{,}000跨可执行 APIexecutable APIs across6262任务跨越三种难度不断增加的设置：不同的 API 交互方式、结构化 API 上的多跳推理以及具有自然语言工具使用策略约束的多源推理。通过针对实时 API 重新执行预测的工具调用来验证正确性，以适应多个有效路径。使用固定的 ReAct 工具将模型功能与代理架构隔离，我们评估了前沿模型和开放权重模型，发现即使是最好的模型在单跳端点类型任务上也只能实现 70.4%，而在组合 API 上则下降到 50-51%；随着推理深度的增加，性能下降超过 50%，并且策略约束的问题暴露出严重的失败（无法回答的查询低至 2.4%）。跟踪分析表明，失败集中在语言介导的推理上——实体消歧、跨源基础，而不是工具调用机制。代码可在 https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA 获取。数据集可用 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRAdomains with tasks spanning three settings of increasing difficulty: diverse API interaction styles, multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and multi-source reasoning with natural-language tool-use policy constraints. Correctness is verified by re-executing predicted tool calls against live APIs, accommodating multiple valid paths. Using a fixed ReAct harness to isolate model capabilities from agent architecture, we evaluate frontier and open-weight models and find that even the best model achieves only 70.4% on single-hop endpoint-style tasks and drops to 50–51% on compositional APIs; performance degrades by over 50% as reasoning depth increases, and policy-constrained questions expose severe failures (as low as 2.4% on unanswerable queries). Trace analysis shows failures concentrate at language-mediated reasoning - entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, rather than tool invocation mechanics. Code is available https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA. Dataset is available https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA

1 简介Introduction

考虑代理解决延迟订单投诉，如图所示Consider an agent resolving a delayed-order complaint as illustrated in Figure1。代理必须消除 CRM 中客户记录的歧义（步骤. The agent must disambiguate a customer record in a CRM (Step11），从承运人文档中提取跟踪标识符（步骤), extract a tracking identifier from carrier documentation (Step22），尽管命名约定不兼容，但仍将其映射到物流 API 参数（步骤), map it to a logistics API parameter despite incompatible naming conventions (Steps33–55），并解释退款政策以确定补偿（步骤), and interpret a refund policy to determine compensation (Steps66–77）。每个步骤都需要语言理解：解析词汇不匹配的实体、跨异构源的基础信息以及解释以自然语言表达的约束。随着代理越来越多地部署在客户支持、商业智能和财务运营领域). Each step requires language understanding: resolving entities under lexical mismatch, grounding information across heterogeneous sources, and interpreting constraints expressed in natural language. As agents are increasingly deployed across customer support, business intelligence, and financial operations24，跨 API 和文档集合的可靠推理成为一项关键挑战。, reliable reasoning across APIs and document collections becomes a critical challenge.

现有的基准测试仅部分捕获此设置。先前的工作评估工具调用等功能Existing benchmarks only partially capture this setting. Prior work evaluates capabilities such as tool invocation(28; 26), 网页导航, web navigation(47; 3)、多轮对话, multi-turn dialogue(10)、多跳文档搜索, multi-hop document search33; 26和政策遵守情况, and policy adherence(49; 42; 15)。然而，这些功能通常是孤立研究的，从而导致跨异构系统的多跳推理的复杂挑战尚未得到充分探索。这种差距具有实际后果：最近的一项调查发现. However, these capabilities are typically studied in isolation, leaving the compounding challenges of multi-hop reasoning across heterogeneous systems underexplored. This gap has practical consequences: a recent survey finds that75%75\%部署代理的团队在没有正式基准的情况下对其进行评估of teams deploying agents evaluate them without formal benchmarks24.

Tasks are organized into three settings of increasing difficulty:(一)(a)多样化的API风格，diverse API styles,(二)(b)通过结构化 API 进行多跳推理，以及multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and(三)(c)使用自然语言工具进行多源推理multi-source reasoning with natural-language tool-use政策policies.

使用固定的 ReAct 工具将模型推理与架构选择隔离，我们评估前沿模型和开放权重模型。最强的模型 (GPT-5.5) 在单跳端点类型任务上实现了 70.4%，但在组合商业智能 API 上仅实现了 50-51%；随着推理深度的增加，大多数模型的准确率会下降 50% 以上，而政策约束的问题尤其困难，无法回答的查询的准确率下降至 2.4%。跟踪分析表明，失败集中在语言介导的步骤（实体消歧、跨源基础和模式对齐），而不是工具调用本身，这表明跨异构源的组合推理仍然是关键瓶颈。Using a fixed ReAct harness to isolate model reasoning from architecture choices, we evaluate frontier and open-weight models. The strongest model (GPT-5.5) achieves 70.4% on single-hop endpoint-style tasks but only 50–51% on compositional business-intelligence APIs; most models lose over 50% accuracy as reasoning depth increases, and policy-constrained questions prove especially difficult, with accuracy on unanswerable queries falling to 2.4%. Trace analysis reveals that failures concentrate at language-mediated steps—entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, and schema alignment—rather than tool invocation itself, indicating that compositional reasoning across heterogeneous sources remains the key bottleneck.

2 相关工作Related Work

我们将 VAKRA 定位在三个维度上：可执行基础、跨源组合推理和轨迹级评估，并重点关注与工具基础代理推理最相关的基准（表We situate VAKRA along three dimensions - executable grounding, cross-source compositional reasoning, and trajectory-level evaluation and focus on benchmarks most relevant to tool-grounded agent reasoning (Table1）。我们强调表中可以合并的三列： 嵌套 API 序列测试参数级组合链，其中一个调用的输出直接参数化下一个调用；多跳查询需要更广泛的顺序推理，包括消除实体歧义、解释中间结果或在操作中进行选择，其中早期结果通知但不需要直接参数化稍后的调用； RAG+API 联合推理还需要从独立文档集合检索输出，以在单个推理链中调节结构化 API 参数（反之亦然）。). We highlight three columns in the table that could be conflated: Nested API Sequences tests parameter-level compositional chaining where one call’s output directly parameterizes the next; Multi-Hop Queries requires broader sequential reasoning including disambiguating entities, interpreting intermediate results, or selecting among actions, where earlier results inform but need not directly parameterize later calls; and RAG+API Joint Reasoning additionally requires retrieval outputs from an independent document collection to condition structured API parameters (or vice versa) within a single reasoning chain.

ToolQA(48)在统一的界面中提供检索和表格查询工具，但不需要代​​理将独立设计的系统与异构模式约定相协调。 VAKRA 明确针对此设置，要求代理将结构化 API 调用与非结构化文档检索交错作为中间步骤，其输出直接参数化单个多跳推理链中的后续工具调用。provides retrieval and tabular query tools within a unified interface, but does not require agents to reconcile independently designed systems with heterogeneous schema conventions. VAKRA explicitly targets this setting, requiring agents to interleave structured API calls with unstructured document retrieval as intermediate steps whose outputs directly parameterize subsequent tool calls within a single multi-hop reasoning chain.

策略约束的工作流程和跟踪级评估：Policy-constrained workflows and trace-level evaluation: τ\tau-长凳-bench(42)本质上是最接近 VAKRA 的基准，但将政策推理限制在狭窄的对话领域，而没有在独立数据源上建立基础决策。瓦克拉有is the closest benchmark to VAKRA in spirit, but confines policy reasoning to narrow conversational domains without grounding decisions across independent data sources. VAKRA has6262领域，并要求代理解释并满足跨多跳 API 和检索操作以自然语言表达的工具使用约束。此外，大多数基准测试都会得出最终答案、个人呼叫准确性domains and requires agents to interpret and satisfy tool-use constraints expressed in natural language across multi-hop API and retrieval actions. Further, most benchmarks score final answers, individual call accuracy(26)，或二元任务成功, or binary task success(47; 36)——无法区分实体解析或策略解释等中间步骤是否有效的指标。相反，VAKRA 通过针对实时 API 重新调用工具调用来验证完整的轨迹，适应多个有效的执行路径，并支持对语言介导的推理中的失败进行有针对性的分析，而不仅仅是工具执行机制。— metrics that cannot distinguish whether intermediate steps such as entity resolution or policy interpretation were valid. VAKRA instead verifies complete trajectories by re-invoking tool calls against live APIs, accommodating multiple valid execution paths and enabling targeted analysis of failures in language-mediated reasoning rather than just tool execution mechanics.

我们将任务分为三种难度逐渐增加的设置（参见附录中的数据样本）We organize tasks into three settings of increasing difficulty (see a data sample in AppendixC.4).

(i) API 样式。(i) API Styles.

正在关注Following5，我们实例化了三种交互样式，通过不同的接口抽象公开底层数据。前两个是由商业智能 (BI) API 推动的，而第三个则反映了可重用的工作流程和面向仪表板的端点。在我们的评估中，我们分别将它们称为 SLOT、SEL 和仪表板 API。, we instantiate three interaction styles that expose the underlying data through different interface abstractions. The first two are motivated by Business Intelligence (BI) APIs, while the third reflects reusable workflow and dashboard-oriented endpoints. We refer to these as SLOT, SEL, and Dashboard APIs respectively in our evaluation.组合接口（称为Compositional interfaces (referred to as插槽SLOT)提供一组最小的通用操作（例如，过滤、聚合、转换），这些操作必须组成多步骤链，需要对中间状态进行显式规划。代理需要在提供的 9 种通用工具中进行选择。provide a minimal set of general-purpose operations (e.g., filtering, aggregation, transformation) that must be composed into multi-step chains, requiring explicit planning over intermediate states. The agent needs to select between 9 general purpose tools provided.扩展功能接口（简称Expanded function interfaces (referred to as选择性ELSEL)将通用函数的参数化具体化为不同的工具，降低每次调用的复杂性，同时增加从更大的候选集中选择正确操作的负担。代理需要从 26 种可用工具中进行选择。materialize parameterizations of generic functions as distinct tools, reducing per-call complexity while increasing the burden of selecting the correct operation from a larger candidate set. The agent needs to select from 26 available tools.端点式接口（称为Endpoint-style interfaces (referred to as仪表板DashboardAPIAPIs）提供高度具体、与查询一致的端点，封装了大多数计算，将挑战转向准确的查询解释和端点选择。该任务每个样本有 116 个可用工具列表（附录中按领域划分的详细工具分布）) provide highly specific, query-aligned endpoints that encapsulate most computation, shifting the challenge toward accurate query interpretation and endpoint selection. This task has an available tool list of 116 per sample (detailed tool distribution by domain in AppendixC.5).

我们构建的任务需要We construct tasks requiring22–55端点式 API 上的步骤推理链（按跳数分布的示例位于附录中）step reasoning chains over endpoint-style APIs (sample distribution by hops is present in AppendixC.2），其中早期调用的输出决定后续步骤的输入。这些任务需要实体消歧、从中间响应中提取参数以及跨异构端点的 API 模式对齐。), where outputs of earlier calls determine inputs to subsequent steps. These tasks require entity disambiguation, parameter extraction from intermediate responses, and API schema alignment across heterogeneous endpoints.

(iii)多跳多源推理。(iii) Multi-hop Multi-Source Reasoning.

我们将之前的设置扩展到需要在单轮和多轮设置中跨结构化 API 和非结构化文档集合进行推理的任务。代理必须执行跨源基础，将从文本中提取的信息与 API 参数对齐，或使用 API 输出来通知检索，同时协调命名和格式中的不一致。除了链接之外，代理还必须决定We extend the previous setting to tasks requiring reasoning across structured APIs and unstructured document collections, in both single- and multi-turn settings. Agents must perform cross-source grounding aligning information extracted from text with API parameters, or using API outputs to inform retrieval while reconciling inconsistencies in naming and format. 3.2 数据质量评估Data Quality Assessment

基于 LLM 的查询生成和会话检索的先前工作表明，自动生成的查询经常受到幻觉约束、不一致的推理链和检索快捷方式工件的影响As prior work on LLM-based query generation and conversational retrieval has shown that automatically generated queries often suffer from hallucinated constraints, inconsistent reasoning chains, and retrieval shortcut artifacts(31; 4; 30)，我们进行了一项小型人体研究, we conducted a small human study for多跳推理Multi-hop Reasoning和and多跳多源推理Multi-hop Multi-Source Reasoning设置来评估法学硕士生成的作文问题的质量（参见附录settings to assess the quality of the LLM-generated compositional questions (See AppendixD).

遵循 MuSiQue 中引入的连接推理原则Following connected reasoning principles introduced in MuSiQue(35)，我们评估每个生成的问题是否需要连贯的多步骤推理而不是断开的快捷推理。我们还采用了受 RAG 评估之前工作启发的评估维度, we evaluate whether each generated question requires coherent multi-step reasoning rather than disconnected shortcut inference. We additionally adopt evaluation dimensions motivated by prior work on RAG evaluation(6), 多跳QA, multi-hop QA(41; 35)，以及NLG评估, and NLG evaluation(25; 18).

4 评价Evaluation

我们通过瀑布机制评估代理的输出：每个阶段都影响下一个阶段，因此失败归因于最早的故障点。We evaluate agent outputs via a waterfall mechanism: each stage gates the next, so failures are attributed to the earliest point of breakdown.

第 1 阶段：工具序列验证：Stage 1: Tool-Sequence Verification:由于代理可以通过替代的有效工具序列来解决任务，因此我们不强制执行严格的步骤级匹配。相反，我们针对实时环境重新执行每个预测的工具调用，并比较Because agents may solve a task via alternative valid tool sequences, we do not enforce strict step-level matching. Instead, we re-execute each predicted tool call against the live environment and compare the工具响应集set of tool responses违背事实。我们首先应用程序化遏制检查来验证是否所有真实信息都已恢复。对于不确定的情况（部分匹配、语义等效、格式差异），我们应用改编自 CRAG 框架的基于 LLM 的判断against the ground truth. We first apply a programmatic containment check verifying whether all ground-truth information is recovered. For inconclusive cases (partial matches, semantic equivalence, formatting differences), we apply an LLM-based judge adapted from the CRAG framework(40)确定预测轨迹是否检索到所有所需信息。to determine whether the predicted trajectory retrieves all required information.

第 2 阶段：最终响应评估：Stage 2: Final Response Evaluation:只有通过第 1 阶段的轨迹才会继续。法学硕士法官会评估代理的最终响应：(i) 工具响应的基础性和 (ii) 答案正确性框架Only trajectories passing Stage 1 proceed. An LLM judge evaluates the agent’s final response for (i) groundedness in tool responses and (ii) the answer correctness framework from6用于计算与真实答案的事实一致性，允许措辞变化（LLM-as-Judge提示包含在附录中）used to calculate factual consistency with the ground-truth answer, allowing phrasing variation (LLM-as-Judge prompts included in AppendixE).

第三阶段：政策遵守：Stage 3: Policy Adherence:对于政策约束的任务，我们确定性地验证没有查阅不允许的来源，而与答案的正确性无关。For policy-constrained tasks, we verify deterministically that no disallowed sources were consulted, independent of answer correctness.

继之前建立 GPT 系列模型作为可靠的法学硕士法官的工作之后Following prior work establishing GPT-family models as reliable LLM-as-Judges40; 46; 9; 14最近的证据表明，面向推理的开放模型可以在 RewardBench 式基准上实现与基于 GPT 的专有评估器相媲美的性能and recent evidence that reasoning-oriented open models can achieve performance competitive with proprietary GPT-based evaluators on RewardBench-style benchmarks34; 19，我们采用GPT-OSS-120B, we employ GPT-OSS-120B23作为阶段 1 和阶段 2 温度的判断模型as the judge model for both Stage 1 and Stage 2 with temperature00.

评分：Scoring:最终得分是所有任务设置的平均值；在多源任务中，多源查询相对于单源查询获得双倍的权重。The final score averages across all task settings; within multi-source tasks, multi-source queries receive double weight relative to single-source queries.

自托管基础设施。Self-Hosted Infrastructure.

所有工具都装在一个All tools ship in a单个 Docker 镜像single Docker image (基准环境benchmark_environ), 每种功能实例化为一个容器。环境承载), instantiated as one container per capability. The environment hosts结构化API工具structured API tools（由针对特定域的 SQLite 数据库的底层 SQL 查询提供支持） 和(which are powered by underlying SQL queries over domain-specific SQLite databases) and检索工具retrieval tools（对 62 个 ChromaDB 集合进行语义搜索 嵌入IBM(semantic search over 62 ChromaDB collections embedded with IBM花岗岩嵌入英语-r2granite-embedding-english-r2）；结构化工具是 作为 SEL/SLOT 的槽填充/选择接口和 REST 端点出现 否则。代理通过 stdio 上的模型上下文协议进行通信；数据库和原始索引永远不会暴露给代理。); structured tools are surfaced as slot-filling/selection interfaces for SEL/SLOT and as REST endpoints otherwise. Agents communicate over the Model Context Protocol on stdio; databases and raw indices are never exposed to agents.

基准运行程序和代理实施：Benchmark Runner and Agent Implementation:运行者协调评估生命周期——加载基准项目， 通过以下方式连接到每个任务容器的 MCP 服务器A runner orchestrates the evaluation lifecycle—loading benchmark items, connecting to each task container’s MCP server viastdio_client, 流式传输验证的工具定义，并记录完整的轨迹（工具 调用、响应、最终答案）到固定每个查询下的结构化 JSON 超时。每个模型都被包裹在制服后面的 LangGraph ReAct 代理中, streaming verified tool definitions, and recording a complete trajectory (tool calls, responses, final answer) to structured JSON under a fixed per-query timeout. Every model is wrapped in a LangGraph ReAct agent behind a uniform代理接口AgentInterface，因此来自与提供商无关的开放式和封闭式模型 工厂（Anthropic、OpenAI、Ollama、LiteLLM、watsonx）的评估相同。 MCP工具转换为类型化LangChain, so open and closed models from a provider-agnostic factory (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, LiteLLM, watsonx) are evaluated identically. MCP tools are converted to typed LangChain结构化工具StructuredTool暴露 完整的参数签名。代理从未被告知任务 特征，即所需的跃点，或者是否需要检索以及它 仅给出其工具和工具使用政策（如果存在）的答案 （见附录s exposing complete parameter signatures. The agent is never told task characteristics i.e, the hops required, or whether retrieval is needed and it answers given only its tools and tool-use policy, if present (see AppendixH.1).

为什么Why反应ReAct?

我们采用We adopt the反应ReAct范式paradigm43三人份 原因。for three reasons.(i) 最小且与模型无关：(i) Minimal and model-agnostic:这是一个裸露的 没有内置计划器或任务的原因-行动-观察循环 分解，因此基准分数反映了基础模型的 能力而不是利用工程，提供了一个公平的共同点 跨模型的基线。it is a bare reason–act–observe loop with no built-in planner or task decomposition, so benchmark scores reflect the underlying model’s capability rather than harness engineering, providing a fair common baseline across models.(ii) 适用于大型工具空间：(ii) Suited to large tool spaces:的 显式推理步骤迫使模型阐明the explicit reasoning step forces the model to articulate为什么why一个工具 被选中并且a tool is selected and如何how它的论点是有根据的，这改善了 工具选择并产生可解释的跟踪——在域中很有价值 暴露至its arguments are grounded, which improves tool selection and yields interpretable traces—valuable when domains expose up to328328工具（附录tools (AppendixC.5). (iii) 自我修正：(iii) Self-correcting:每个工具响应（错误、空 结果，格式错误的输出）作为观察反馈，让 代理在同一集中修改其操作而不是失败 默默地。each tool response (an error, an empty result, a malformed output) is fed back as an observation, letting the agent revise its action within the same episode rather than failing silently.

5 结果Results

我们的实验围绕三个研究问题进行。Our experiments are organized around three research questions.RQ1（API 样式）：RQ1 (API Styles):模型如何在不同的 API 交互范例（SLOT、SEL、Dashboard）中执行，以及工具调用管道中的故障集中在哪里？How do models perform across different API interaction paradigms (SLOT, SEL, Dashboard), and where in the tool-calling pipeline do failures concentrate?RQ2（多跳推理）：RQ2 (Multi-hop Reasoning):随着推理跳数的增加，性能如何下降？How does performance degrade as the number of reasoning hops increases?RQ3（多源推理和政策遵守）：RQ3 (Multi-Source Reasoning & Policy Adherence):模型如何处理将结构化 API 与文档检索相结合的推理，以及它们能否遵守自然语言工具使用策略？How do models handle reasoning that combines structured APIs with document retrieval, and can they adhere to natural-language tool-use policies?

我们在表中总结了全套结果We summarize the full set of results in Table3.

与调查结果一致Consistent with findings in5，我们对 API 样式的实验（表, our experiments on API styles (Table3) 证明所有模型都能找到 BI API) demonstrate that all models find the BI APIs66 6相比之下In contrast to5，我们支持在我们的评估框架中验证替代迹线, we support verification of alternate traces in our evaluation framework与仪表板 API 相比，使用起来更具挑战性。 GPT5.5在所有API风格上表现最好，中等规模模型有时可以胜过大规模开源模型（例如：Qwen2.5B-72B-Instruct）。在 BI API 集合中，模型通常在 SLOT 子集上比 SEL 表现得更好 - SLOT 具有较少数量的通用工具，需要填充大量参数值，而 SEL 集合具有更大的工具集和每个工具的参数较少。值得注意的是，每个子集（BI 与 Dashboard）内模型的相对性能顺序非常不同（例如：BI API Granite-4h-small 上性能最低的模型是more challenging to work with as compared to Dashboard APIs. GPT5.5 performs the best on all API styles, and medium-scale models can sometimes outperform large-scale open source models (eg: Qwen2.5B-72B-Instruct). Within the BI APIs collection, models usually tend to perform better on the SLOT subset than SEL - the SLOT has a smaller number of generic tools with a large number of parameter values to fill, while the SEL collection has a larger set of tools and fewer parameters per tool. It is also interesting to note that the relative order of performance for models within each subset (BI vs Dashboard) is very different (eg: the lowest-performing model on BI APIs Granite-4h-small is比better thanDashboard API 任务上的许多大型模型包括 Qwen3.5-397B、GLM-5.1）。many large models on the Dashboard API tasks including Qwen3.5-397B, GLM-5.1).

5.2 多跳和多源推理MultiHop and Multi-source Reasoning

多跳推理。Multi-hop Reasoning.从仪表板 API 到多跳链，性能大幅下降（表Performance drops substantially from Dashboard APIs to multi-hop chains (Table3）：模型必须对中间工具输出进行推理，以识别后续工具及其参数化。退化随着跳数的增加而加剧——随着链的延长，除了 GPT-5.5 之外的所有模型都会失去超过 50% 的准确度（附录图): models must reason over intermediate tool outputs to identify subsequent tools and their parameterization. The degradation steepens with hop count—all models except GPT-5.5 lose over 50% accuracy as chains lengthen (Appendix Figure3).

多跳多源推理。Multi-hop Multi-Source Reasoning.添加检索步骤进一步增加了难度，正如较低的分数所反映的那样 表Adding retrieval steps further compounds difficulty, as reflected in the lower scores in Table3（其中包括受政策约束的实例）。封闭模型的表现相当，但 GPT-5.5 除外，它保持了一致的领先地位。(which include policy-constrained instances). Closed models perform comparably, with the exception of GPT-5.5 which maintains a consistent lead.

工具使用政策。Tool-use Policy.为了将跨源跃点的影响与政策约束分开，表To disentangle effects of cross-source hops from policy constraints, Table3报告分为三个子类别：政策使问题无法回答、政策没有效果、没有政策。总体趋势在子类别中保持不变，但无法回答的问题暴露了特定于模型的明显弱点：Claude Opus 4.7 得分为 2.4%（而第二低的模型为 3.7%），这表明它无法识别政策何时使问题无法回答，而是强制给出答案。 GLM-5.1 单独处理长工具响应。reports three sub-categories: policy makes the question unanswerable, policy has no effect, and no policy. Overall trends hold across sub-categories, but unanswerable questions expose sharp model-specific weaknesses: Claude Opus 4.7 scores 2.4% (vs. 3.7% for the next-lowest models), suggesting it fails to recognize when a policy renders a question unanswerable and instead forces an answer. GLM-5.1 struggles separately with processing long tool responses.

5.3 分析Analysis

API 样式：API Styles:表Table4显示跨 Dashboard API、SEL 和 SLOT API 进行工具调用的每个阶段中幸存的实例百分比。可以看出，SEL 和 SLOT 的工具调用中的错误遵循非常不同的模式。在 SEL 中，一旦识别出正确的工具，它通常会成功填充参数名称及其值，这一点可以通过相对平坦的错误曲线来证明。shows the percentage of instances surviving each stage of tool calling across Dashboard APIs, SEL and SLOT APIs. As can be seen the errors in tool-calling for SEL and SLOT follow very different patterns. In SEL, once a correct tool is identified, it is usually successful at populating the argument names and their values as evidenced by the relatively flat error profile across工具Tool（工具识别），(tool identification),精氨酸ArgN（参数识别）和(argument identification) and精氨酸VArgV（参数参数化）。另一方面，错误可以追溯到工具调用的所有阶段，ArgV 阶段幸存实例相对急剧下降就证明了这一点。(argument parameterization). On the other hand, errors can be traced to all stages of tool-calling as evidenced by the relatively steeper drop in the surviving instances at the ArgV stage.

除了工具选择失败之外，接地错误在剩余错误中也占很大比例。我们将它们分为两类（表Beyond tool-selection failures, grounding errors account for a large share of remaining mistakes. We categorize these into two types (Table5)：(1) 提取失败，即模型无法准确解析或截断长工具响应；(2) 幻觉，即模型生成查询或工具输出不支持的信息。幻觉在 BI 和 仪表板 API，尽管仪表板 API 也经常出现提取失败的情况，这可能是由于模型倾向于截断较长的结构化响应。): (1) extraction failures, where models inaccurately parse or truncate long tool responses, and (2) hallucinations, where models generate information unsupported by the query or tool output. Hallucinations dominate grounding errors in both BI and Dashboard APIs, though Dashboard APIs also exhibit frequent extraction failures likely due to longer structured responses that models tend to truncate.

多跳和多源推理：Multi-hop and Multi-Source Reasoning:图Figure2显示当问题需要不同深度的多跳推理时模型的性能如何变化。 1-hop API 与评估仪表板查询的任务相同shows how the performance of models varies when questions require different depths of multi-hop reasoning. 1-hop APIs are the same task as evaluating the dashboard queries77 7请注意，我们在此集合中使用一组不同的查询Note we use a different set of queries in this collection当模型遇到 2 跳 API 问题时，性能会下降。需要使用检索器的问题的性能非常低，尽管许多模型在 2 跳 RAG-API 问题上表现出性能峰值（例如：Gemini-3-flash-preview）。这可能是由于仪表板 API 上某些模型的相对较强的性能所解释的，因此，一旦使用工具调用识别出正确的中间答案，检索查询可能会更成功。有趣的是，我们发现在需要单个文档检索器调用（1 跳 RAG）的问题上， GPT-OSS-120B 尝试直接从参数知识返回答案，但当问题似乎需要多个跃点时，它会回答问题。最后，Qwen3.5-397B 和 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 是仅 RAG 跃点的最佳性能模型，而 GPT5.5 仍然是多源跃点的最强模型。and performance drops when models encounter 2-hop API questions. Questions that require the use of the retriever have very low-performance though many models show a spike in performance on 2-hop RAG-API questions (eg: Gemini-3-flash-preview. This is likely explained by the relatively strong performance of some models on the dashboard APIs, and thus, once the correct intermediate answer is identified using the tool-call, the retrieval query is likely to be more successful. Interestingly, we find that on questions that require a single document retriever call (1-hop RAG), GPT-OSS-120B tries to directly return the answer from parameter knowledge, though when the question appears to require multiple hops, it answers the question. Lastly, Qwen3.5-397B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct are best performing models for RAG-only hops, with GPT5.5 continuing to be the strongest model for multi-source hops.

我们还研究了多跳推理链以 API 调用结束的子集的性能。我们发现，在大型模型上，大约 40-45% 的错误可以追踪到答案提取/接地，尽管当跳跃涉及 RAG 和 API 时，这一比例会增加到近 70-75%。见附录We also studied the performance on a subset where a mulit-hop reasoning chain ended with an API invocation. We find that on large models about 40-45% of the errors can be tracked to answer-extraction/grounding though this increases to nearly 70-75% when the hops involve RAG followed by an API. See AppendixB了解详情。for details.

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 VAKRA，这是一个评估跨可执行 API 和跨越 62 个领域的文档集合的代理推理的基准。与之前单独评估工具调用、检索、多跳推理或策略遵守情况的基准不同，VAKRA 是第一个在单个推理链中要求所有这些的基准——代理必须组成嵌套的 API 序列、跨结构化和非结构化源的基础信息，并尊重自然语言工具使用约束，所有这些都通过针对实时数据库支持的 API 重新执行预测来验证，这些 API 适应多个有效的解决方案路径。通过将任务组织成三个逐渐具有挑战性的设置并在固定的 ReAct 工具下评估模型，我们将推理功能与代理架构隔离开来。We presented VAKRA, a benchmark for evaluating agentic reasoning across executable APIs and document collections spanning 62 domains. Unlike prior benchmarks that evaluate tool calling, retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, or policy adherence in isolation, VAKRA is the first to require all of these within a single reasoning chain—agents must compose nested API sequences, ground information across structured and unstructured sources, and respect natural-language tool-use constraints, all verified by re-executing predictions against live database-backed APIs that accommodate multiple valid solution paths. By organizing tasks into three progressively challenging settings and evaluating models under a fixed ReAct harness, we isolate reasoning capabilities from agent architecture.

我们的实验得出了三个关键发现。首先，API 交互范式对难度有很大影响：在端点式 API 上表现出色的模型通常在组合业务智能 API 上表现不佳，反之亦然，这表明没有单一功能是工具使用熟练程度的基础。其次，多跳推理仍然脆弱——随着推理深度的增加，大多数模型的准确性会下降 50% 以上，失败集中在语言介导的步骤（实体消歧、跨源基础、模式对齐），而不是工具调用机制。第三，工具使用政策的遵守是一个严重的弱点：当政策使问题无法回答时，即使是前沿模型也无法认识到这一点，准确率降至 2.4%。Our experiments yield three key findings. First, API interaction paradigm strongly influences difficulty: models that excel on endpoint-style APIs often struggle on compositional business-intelligence APIs, and vice versa, indicating that no single capability underlies tool-use proficiency. Second, multi-hop reasoning remains fragile—most models lose over 50% accuracy as reasoning depth increases, with failures concentrating at language-mediated steps (entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, schema alignment) rather than tool invocation mechanics. Third, tool-use policy adherence is a critical weakness: when policies render questions unanswerable, even frontier models fail to recognize this, with accuracy falling as low as 2.4%.

这些结果表明，改进代理系统需要在组合推理和约束解释方面取得进展，而不仅仅是更好的工具调用界面。These results suggest that improving agentic systems requires advances in compositional reasoning and constraint interpretation, not merely better tool-calling interfaces.

C.1 预期用途Intended Use

我们仔细审查了本工作中使用的所有数据集和工件，以确保它们不包含个人身份信息 (PII)、攻击性内容或敏感用户数据。该基准是根据公开的研究数据集、结构化数据库和用于学术用途的知识源构建的，不包括真实的用户对话、私营企业日志或人类受试者数据。我们对现有资源（包括 BIRD-SQL、Wikidata5M 和相关检索语料库）的使用与其预期的研究和评估目的一致。发布的基准工件仅用于评估使用工具的语言代理的非商业研究用途，不应部署用于生产决策或监视应用程序。根据这些限制，数据集和随附的基准框架将在 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 许可证下发布。We carefully reviewed all datasets and artifacts used in this work to ensure they do not contain personally identifiable information (PII), offensive content, or sensitive user data. The benchmark is constructed from publicly available research datasets, structured databases, and knowledge sources intended for academic use, and does not include real user conversations, private enterprise logs, or human subject data. Our use of existing resources, including BIRD-SQL, Wikidata5M, and related retrieval corpora, is consistent with their intended research and evaluation purposes. The released benchmark artifacts are intended solely for non-commercial research use in evaluating tool-using language agents and should not be deployed for production decision-making or surveillance applications. In accordance with these constraints, the dataset and accompanying benchmark framework would be released under the CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license.

C.3 基准数据分割说明Benchmark Data split description

BIRD-SQL 数据集The BIRD-SQL dataset12包含超过 12,751 个独特的问题-SQL 对。这些查询是我们数据集中所有任务所使用的基本查询。以下是我们的基准测试中三个设置的查询选择逻辑contains over 12,751 unique question-SQL pairs. These queries are the base queries utilized for all the tasks in our dataset. Following is the logic used for query selection for the three settings in our benchmark

  1. 1.

    只有有限数量的查询具有可能与基本 Wikidata5m 段落有联系的实体Only a limited number of queries had entities which could have linkages with base Wikidata5m passages(37)需要形成多跳和多源查询生成所需的知识图。因此，任何可以通过检索器问题连接的查询仅用于构建 API-RAG 风格的联合推理查询。知识图构建和查询生成的详细描述包含在章节中required to form a knowledge graph needed for Multihop and Multisource query generation. So, any query which could be connected via an retriever question was only used for the purpose of constructing API-RAG style joint reasoning queries. A detailed description of the knowledge graph construction and query generation is included in sectionI。这些 API-RAG 查询仅发生在多跳多源设置中。. These API-RAG queries occur only in the multihop multisource setting.

  2. 2.

    可以基于查询实体和应答实体形成（API-API）链接的查询被保留用于数据集的多跳设置。Queries which could form (API-API) linkages based on the query entities and answer entities were reserved for multihop setting of the dataset.

  3. 3.

    由于实体无法链接到其他查询或其答案而无法添加到知识图中的所有其他查询都被用作仪表板 API 任务的查询。All the other queries which couldn’t be added to the knowledge graphs due to entities which couldn’t be linked to other queries or their answers were used as the queries for the Dashboard APIs task.

  4. 4.

    由于商业智能 API（即 SEL 和 SLOT）的嵌套行为已经导致相对更困难的任务，因此用于数据集分割的查询可能与其他设置重叠。As the nesting behaviour of Business Intelligence APIs (i.e. SEL and SLOT) already leads to a relatively more difficult task the queries used for this split of the dataset could be overlapping with other settings.

  5. 5.

    我们的数据集的调整集和测试集之间不共享 BIRD-SQL 组件。No component BIRD-SQL are shared between the tuning and test set of our dataset.

附录DAppendix D人工评估详情Human Evaluation Details

我们对生成的数据进行详细的人工评估We perform detailed human evaluation for generated多跳推理Multi-hop Reasoning和and多跳多源推理Multi-hop Multi-Source Reasoning验证自动生成的推理链的组成质量的问题。每个问题均由独立注释questions to validate the compositional quality of automatically generated reasoning chains. Each question is independently annotated by33注释者。显示注释器： (i) 生成的合并查询， (ii) 组合过程中使用的组件查询， (iii) 真实工具链， (iv) 工具响应， (v) 检索基于 RAG 设置的文档，以及 (vi) 最终的真实答案。annotators. Annotators are shown: (i) the generated merged query, (ii) the component queries used during composition, (iii) ground-truth tool chains, (iv) tool responses, (v) retrieved documents for RAG-based settings, and (vi) the final ground-truth answer.

注释界面支持带有可悬停指标定义的评分标准引导评分和键盘辅助注释，以提高一致性和注释吞吐量。The annotation interface supports rubric-guided scoring with hoverable metric definitions and keyboard-assisted annotation to improve consistency and annotation throughput.

评估指标。Evaluation Metrics.

我们的评估维度是由先前的组合推理工作推动的Our evaluation dimensions are motivated by prior work on compositional reasoning(35; 41), 查询生成, query generation(31; 4; 30)，以及 RAG 系统中的忠实度评估, and faithfulness evaluation in RAG systems(6).

  • •

    忠诚度得分：Faithfulness Score:衡量生成的查询是否仅包含基于组件查询的信息，而不引入不支持的实体、关系或约束。Measures whether the generated query contains only information grounded in the component queries without introducing unsupported entities, relations, or constraints.

  • •

    逻辑一致性得分：Logical Consistency Score:衡量生成的查询是否包含矛盾或逻辑上不兼容的约束，同时保留连贯的推理链。Measures whether the generated query contains contradictory or logically incompatible constraints while preserving a coherent reasoning chain.

  • •

    答案泄漏分数：Answer Leakage Score:衡量生成的查询是否显式或隐式地揭示中间跳跃或最终答案，从而使推理过程变得简单。Measures whether the generated query explicitly or implicitly reveals intermediate-hop or final answers, making the reasoning process trivial.

  • •

    上下文充分性得分：Context Sufficiency Score:衡量生成的问题是否包含足够的信息来执行所需的推理链并填充工具参数。Measures whether the generated question contains sufficient information to execute the required reasoning chain and populate tool arguments.

  • •

    上下文充分性分数（仅适用于带有文档的问题）：Context Sufficiency Score (Applicable only for questions with documents):衡量检索到的文档是否包含足够的证据来回答查询的基于检索的部分。Measures whether retrieved documents contain sufficient evidence to answer the retrieval-grounded component of the query.

  • •

    跨跳实体一致性分数（仅适用于带有文档的问题）：Cross-Hop Entity Consistency Score (Applicable only for questions with documents):衡量 API 和检索跃点之间传播的实体是否正确推断并基于检索到的证据。Measures whether entities propagated between API and retrieval hops are correctly inferred and grounded in retrieved evidence.

评分标准Scoring Scale

所有指标均使用基于标题的序数进行评估All metrics are evaluated using a rubric-based ordinal11–44评分方案。评分框架的灵感来自于摘要和 RAG 评估中使用的分级事实性和连贯性评估scoring scheme. The scoring framework is inspired by graded factuality and coherence evaluation used in summarization and RAG evaluation(20)。较低的分数对应于严重的推理失败，而较高的分数对应于完全连贯且有根据的组合推理。. Lower scores correspond to severe reasoning failures, while higher scores correspond to fully coherent and grounded compositional reasoning.

附录EAppendix E评估详情Evaluation Details

政策遵守情况检查Policy Adherence Check

对于受策略约束的任务，我们检查代理的工具调用跟踪并验证是否未咨询任何不允许的来源。这是确定性的：每个工具调用都标有其源类型（由于生成管道的性质，API 或检索集合），并且我们根据每个查询的策略规范进行检查。代理可能会在违反策略的情况下产生正确的最终答案——此类痕迹被标记为失败。For policy-constrained tasks, we inspect the agent’s tool-call trace and verify that no disallowed sources were consulted. This is deterministic: each tool call is tagged with its source type (API or retrieval collection due to the nature of our generation pipeline), and we check against the per-query policy specification. An agent may produce the correct final answer while violating a policy – such traces are marked as failures.

正文将 VAKRA 描述为一个由 单个 Docker 映像并使用一个命令启动。本附录详细说明了 架构：如何构建图像，如何将数据与代码分开，如何 容器启动，以及如何按需生成 MCP 服务器。The main text describes VAKRAas a self-hosted environment built from a single Docker image and brought up with one command. This appendix details that architecture: how the image is built, how data is kept separate from code, how containers boot, and how MCP servers are spawned on demand.

一张图像，四个容器。One image, four containers.

整个环境是一个The entire environment is a单身single图像，image,基准环境benchmark_environ, 建造一次从, built once fromdocker/Dockerfile.unified并实例化为and instantiated bydocker-compose.yml每种功能作为一个容器 （as one container per capability (ability_1_bi_apiscapability_1_bi_apis通过throughCapability_4_多圈capability_4_multiturn）。 该映像捆绑了所有四个工具后端 - M3 REST 服务器、 检索器服务器、SEL/SLOT Python 工具服务器和 BPO 服务器——因此 功能纯粹是通过配置来选择的，而不是通过不同的图像来选择的。一个 关键结果：四个任务设置在其代码中字节相同，并且 依赖性，因此跨能力比较不能被混淆 环境漂移。). The image bundles all four tool backends—the M3 REST server, the retriever server, the SEL/SLOT Python-tools server, and the BPO server—so a capability is selected purely by configuration, never by a different image. A key consequence: the four task settings are byte-identical in their code and dependencies, so cross-capability comparisons cannot be confounded by environment drift.

的The生成文件Makefile涵盖了整个生命周期。首次设置是单一的 目标，wraps the whole lifecycle. First-time setup is a single target,进行设置make setup，其中链, which chains下载download（从获取数据 抱脸）(fetch data from HuggingFace)→\rightarrow 建造build（构建图像）(build the image)→\rightarrow 测试test（冒烟测试）(smoke test)→\rightarrow 开始start (码头工人组成 向上-ddocker compose up -d) →\rightarrow 验证validate。容器运行时和 Python解释器是自动检测的，所以. Both the container runtime and the Python interpreter are auto-detected, so泊坞窗docker和and播客podman主机可互换支持。两个验证层在任何层之前运行 基准：hosts are supported interchangeably. Two verification layers run before any benchmark:进行测试make test旋转一个一次性容器并检查 所需的文件存在并且 MCP 服务器完成协议握手；spins up a throwaway container and checks that required files exist and that the MCP servers complete the protocol handshake;使验证make validate检查实时 MCP 连接与正在运行的连接 容器。在运行时，撰写文件集checks live MCP connections against the running containers. At runtime, the compose file setsMCP_VERIFY_CHECKSUMS=1, 因此默认情况下会强制执行工具完整性校验和。, so the tool-integrity checksums are enforced by default.

对于交互式检查，可选的撰写覆盖 （For interactive inspection, an optional compose override (docker-compose.ports.yml) 将内部 FastAPI 端口映射到主机 因此可以直接浏览Swagger UI和OpenAPI规范；使用的 MCP 路径 根据基准测试，不需要暴露端口。这些部件共同实现了 正文中阐述的设计目标：一个自托管的、确定性的环境 没有外部服务依赖性，任何用户都可以使用单个 命令。) maps the internal FastAPI ports to the host so the Swagger UI and OpenAPI specs can be browsed directly; the MCP path used by the benchmark needs no exposed ports. Together, these pieces realize the design goal stated in the main text: a self-hosted, deterministic environment with no external service dependencies that any user can reproduce with a single command.

一、2I.2对话轨迹生成Dialogue Trajectory Generation

多轮对话是通过对查询连接图的深度优先遍历生成的，其动机是组合问题生成方法Multi-turn dialogues are generated via depth-first traversal over the query connectivity graph, motivated by the compositional question generation approach of35。在每个遍历步骤中，都有一个跳数. At each traversal step, a hop counth∈{1,2,3}h\in\{1,2,3\}用权重采样is sampled with weights(0.10,0.60,0.30)(0.10,0.60,0.30)，使数据集偏向两跳推理链，同时仍包含较短和较长的链以实现多样性。遍历段按顺序组成最多可达的轨迹, biasing the dataset toward two-hop reasoning chains while still including shorter and longer chains for diversity. Traversal segments are sequentially composed into trajectories of up to77轮流代表链式 API 推理。turns representing chained API reasoning.

对于每个候选轨迹，法学硕士都会生成一个自然语言问题，需要执行完整的链才能回答。生成的问题由 LLM 法官评估：For each candidate trajectory, an LLM generates a natural-language question that requires executing the full chain to answer. The generated question is evaluated by an LLM judge for:

  • •

    可回答性Answerability：问题必须要求链中的所有跃点（无捷径）。: The question must require all hops in the chain (no shortcuts).

  • •

    自然性Naturalness：问题必须被理解为一个合理的用户查询，而不是子查询的机械组合。: The question must read as a plausible user query, not a mechanical composition of sub-queries.

  • •

    接地气Groundedness：答案必须可以从链中的 API 响应中得出。: The answer must be derivable from the API responses in the chain.

验证失败的问题将被重写（最多Questions failing validation are rewritten (up to22尝试）或被丢弃。attempts) or discarded.

I.3 检索增强Retrieval Augmentation

为了生成 API+RAG 任务，我们将基于检索的边引入到连接图中。用于连接实体的知识图关系To produce API+RAG tasks, we introduce retrieval-based edges into the connectivity graph. For knowledge graph relations connecting entitieseie_{i}和andeje_{j}，系统检索维基百科段落（来自 ClapNQ, the system retrieves Wikipedia passages (from ClapNQ(29)）与相应的维基数据 QID 关联并提取提及两个链接实体的段落。然后，法学硕士会生成一个组合问题，需要 API 调用和检索步骤，并验证上述的基础性和自然性。) associated with the corresponding Wikidata QIDs and extracts paragraphs mentioning both linked entities. An LLM then generates a combined question that requires both an API call and a retrieval step, validated for groundedness and naturalness as above.

这会产生具有混合源类型模式（例如 API）的推理链This produces reasoning chains with mixed source-type patterns such as API→\to拉格，拉格RAG, RAG→\toAPI 和 APIAPI, and API→\toRAG→\toAPI，其中检索输出直接调节后续 API 参数，反之亦然。API, where retrieval outputs directly condition subsequent API parameters or vice versa.

I.4 仅检索多跳对话Retrieval-Only Multi-Hop Dialogues

为了补充 API+RAG 设置，我们按照以下方法生成仅检索的多轮对话To complement the API+RAG setting, we generate retrieval-only multi-turn dialogues following the methodology of11。一个. A用户user代理从特定领域的 ClapNQ 文档生成基于实体的问题，并与agent generates entity-grounded questions from domain-specific ClapNQ documents, interleaved with代理人agent回应。每个查询都会根据域数据库模式进行验证，以确保它无法通过结构化 API 得到答复 - API 可回答的查询将作为跨源可回答性过滤的一部分被删除。另外，还根据检索到的段落验证响应的基础性。responses. Each query is validated against the domain database schema to ensure it cannot be answered via structured APIs—API-answerable queries are removed as part of cross-source answerability filtering. Responses are additionally verified for groundedness against retrieved passages.

为了引入多跳结构，LLM 将连续的问题-答案对合并到一个桥接查询中，该桥接查询省略了中间答案，产生以下形式的模式To introduce multi-hop structure, sequential question-answer pairs are merged by an LLM into a single bridging query that omits the intermediate answer, producing patterns of the form(RAG-RAG)(RAG)⋯\cdots or (RAG)(RAG-RAG)⋯\cdots。由此产生的对话形成了干净的仅供检索的轨迹，确保了跨源的不可回答性。该子管道的完整详细信息见附录. The resulting dialogues form clean retrieval-only trajectories ensuring cross-source unanswerability. Full details of this sub-pipeline appear in AppendixJ.

I.5 检索索引构建Retrieval Index Construction

特定领域的检索索引是根据来自 Wikidata5M 和 ClapNQ 的文档构建的。为了最大限度地减少跨源可回答性（即确保 RAG 问题无法通过 API 得到回答，反之亦然），我们应用基于 LLM 的过滤程序：Domain-specific retrieval indices are constructed from documents sourced from Wikidata5M and ClapNQ. To minimize cross-source answerability (i.e., ensuring RAG questions cannot be answered via APIs and vice versa), we apply an LLM-based filtering procedure:

  1. 1.

    能够回答任何现有 API 查询的文档将被识别并从检索语料库中删除。Documents capable of answering any existing API query are identified and removed from the retrieval corpus.

  2. 2.

    可通过结构化 API 应答的 RAG 查询将从任务集中丢弃。RAG queries answerable via structured APIs are discarded from the task set.

  3. 3.

    检查跨域污染：删除可以回答来自不相关域的查询的文档。Cross-domain contamination is checked: documents that can answer queries from unrelated domains are removed.

  4. 4.

    对幸存的文档进行采样Surviving documents are sampled to20,00020{,}000每个域并使用 ChromaDB 进行索引，形成基于文档的任务的检索工具。per domain and indexed using ChromaDB, forming the retrieval tools for document-grounded tasks.

附录JAppendix J多轮 RAG 基准数据生成管道Multi-Turn RAG Benchmark Data Generation Pipeline

本节介绍我们用于生成高质量多轮会话 RAG（检索增强生成）基准数据的自动化管道。该管道采用多个具有复杂质量控制机制的人工智能代理，以确保数据完整性并防止污染。在自动对话和查询生成之后，四名人工注释者迭代地过滤掉不满足所需评估严格性的样本，包括与模糊性、基础不足或推理复杂性有限相关的问题。最终基准由 100 个经过注释和验证过程后保留的精心策划的对话组成。This section describes our automated pipeline for generating high-quality multi-turn conversational RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) benchmark data. The pipeline employs multiple AI agents with sophisticated quality control mechanisms to ensure data integrity and prevent contamination. Following automated dialogue and query generation, four human annotators iteratively filter out samples that do not satisfy the desired evaluation rigor, including issues related to ambiguity, insufficient grounding, or limited reasoning complexity. The final benchmark consists of 100 carefully curated dialogues retained after this annotation and validation process.

J.1 概述Overview

Multi-RAG Pipeline 是一个自动化系统，可生成多轮对话数据，用于跨多个域评估 RAG 系统。该管道协调专业代理之间的交互，同时在每个步骤进行严格的质量检查，以确保生成的数据干净、可靠且适合基准测试目的。The Multi-RAG Pipeline is an automated system that generates multi-turn conversational data for evaluating RAG systems across multiple domains. The pipeline orchestrates interactions between specialized agents while applying rigorous quality checks at each step to ensure the generated data is clean, grounded, and suitable for benchmarking purposes.

J.2 系统架构System Architecture

该管道由四个主要组件组成：The pipeline consists of four primary components:

  • •

    用户代理User Agent：模拟具有不同问题类型的真实用户查询: Simulates realistic user queries with diverse question types

  • •

    RAG代理RAG Agent：根据检索到的文档生成响应: Generates responses based on retrieved documents

  • •

    答案选择代理Answer Selection Agent：验证并选择适当的响应: Validates and selects appropriate responses

J.2.1 代理配置Agent Configuration

每个代理都配置有特定的参数：Each agent is configured with specific parameters:

  • •

    模型提供者Model Provider：支持OpenAI模型: Supports OpenAI models

  • •

    温度Temperature：设置为 0.0 用于确定性 RAG 响应和 LLM 判断，1.0 用于不同的用户查询: Set to 0.0 for deterministic RAG responses and LLM judege, 1.0 for diverse user queries

  • •

    最大代币数Max Tokens: 4096 代币用于全面回复: 4096 tokens for comprehensive responses

  • •

    取样Sampling：用户代理使用: User agent usesn=3n=3用于生成多个查询候选（参见附录for generating multiple query candidates (see AppendixJ.7.2)

J.3 数据生成过程Data Generation Process

管道通过以下迭代过程生成多轮对话：The pipeline generates multi-turn conversations through the following iterative process:

J.3.1 对话初始化Conversation Initialization

对于每个对话样本：For each conversation sample:

  1. 1.

    将 Elasticsearch 索引设置为Set Elasticsearch index to拍拍NQClapNQ，配置域名、描述和关键字以进行特定于域的上下文检索。, configure domain name, description and keywords for domain-specific context retrieval.

  2. 2.

    初始化与特定领域上下文的对话Initialize conversation with domain-specific context from拍拍NQClapNQ

  3. 3.

    重置对话历史记录和元数据Reset conversation history and metadata

J.3.2 回合生成循环Turn Generation Loop

对话中的每一轮都遵循以下工作流程：Each turn in the conversation follows this workflow:

第 1 步：用户查询生成Step 1: User Query Generation

用户代理根据以下内容生成查询：The User Agent generates a query based on:

  1. 1.

    从特定领域的语料库中检索文档以及之前回合的对话历史记录Retrieved documents from the domain-specific corpus plus Conversation history from previous turns

  2. 2.

    确定查询类型（基于实体、事实等）Determine query type (entity-based, factoid, etc.)

该代理采用复杂的提示（参见附录The agent employs sophisticated prompts (see AppendixJ.7）和对话，记录上下文以生成问题，包括：) and conversation, document context to generate questions including:

  • •

    实体问题Entity questions：答案是特定命名实体的查询。（参见附录: Queries whose answer is a specific named entity.(see AppendixJ.7.1)

  • •

    事实问题Factoid questions：寻求上述名称实体的简短事实信息。: Seeking brief, factual information for the name entity mentioned above.

第 2 步：RAG 响应生成Step 2: RAG Response Generation

RAG 代理：The RAG Agent:

  1. 1.

    接收与检索到的段落连接的用户查询。Receives the user query concatenated with retrieved passages.

  2. 2.

    生成对用户查询的响应。使用附录所示的提示模板Generates response to the user query. Uses the prompt template shown in AppendixJ.7.3

步骤3：多跳查询合并Step 3: Multi-hop Query Merging

为了创建多跳查询，系统可以合并顺序问题-答案对：For creating multi-hop queries, the system can merge sequential question-answer pairs:

  1. 1.

    随机选择合并位置（第1回合或第3回合）Randomly selects merge position (turn 1 or turn 3)

  2. 2.

    从选定的回合中提取第一个查询、答案和第二个查询Extracts first query, answer, and second query from selected turns

  3. 3.

    使用 LLM 生成合并查询，合并两个问题，而不提及中间答案Uses LLM to generate merged query that combines both questions without mentioning intermediate answer

  4. 4.

    验证合并查询的自然性Validates naturalness of merged query

  5. 5.

    使用合并查询创建新对话，用多跳模式替换原始轮次：Creates new conversation with merged query replacing original turns with multi-hop patterns:(RAG-RAG)(RAG)(RAG) or (RAG)(RAG)(RAG-RAG)

第四步：数据记录Step 4: Data Recording

验证成功后，系统记录：Upon successful validation, the system records:

  • •

    用户查询和元数据（实体、文档、查询类型）User query and metadata (entity, document, query type)

  • •

    RAG 回复和支持文件RAG response and supporting documents

  • •

    带有检索器信息和检索到的文档块的黄金序列Gold sequence with retriever information and retrieved document chunks

J.4 质量控制机制Quality Control Mechanisms

该管道实施多层质量控制，以确保数据完整性并防止污染。The pipeline implements multiple layers of quality control to ensure data integrity and prevent contamination.

J.4.1 世代质量检查In-Generation Quality Checks

生成过程中应用的质量检查（步骤 1-3 之间）：Quality checks applied during the generation process (between Steps 1-3):

  1. 1.

    可回答性检查Answerability Check:

    • •

      构建包括新查询的对话历史记录Constructs conversation history including the new query

    • •

      使用LLM法官（见附录Uses LLM judge (see AppendixJ.7.4）来分析RAG查询是否可以通过查询结构化数据库来回答) to analyze whether RAG queries can be answered by querying structured databases

    • •

      使用LLM法官（见附录Uses LLM judge (see AppendixJ.7.5）来分析API查询是否可以通过检索文档来回答。) to analyze whether API queries can be answered by retriving documents.

    • •

      如果可以通过 SQL/API 调用回答 RAG 查询，则拒绝/放弃对话，反之亦然。Rejects/drops the conversation if the RAG query can be answered via SQL/API calls, also vice versa.

    • •

      通过防止 API 负责的污染确保纯粹的 RAG 评估，反之亦然。Ensures pure RAG evaluation by preventing API-answerable contamination, and vice versa.

  2. 2.

    接地验证Groundedness Verification：使用基于 LLM 的验证来验证检索到的文档是否确实支持查询的答案: Verify answers to the queries are factually supported by retrieved documents using LLM-based validation

  3. 3.

    无法回答的检测Unanswerability Detection：拒绝包含“我无法回答”的回复或拒绝回答问题。: Rejects responses containing "I can not answer" or reject answering the question.

  4. 4.

    对话拒绝Conversation Rejection：如果任何质量检查失败，则丢弃整个对话: Discards entire conversation if any quality check fails

  5. 5.

    完整性检查Completeness Check：确保对话达到目标轮数（默认值：6）: Ensures conversations reach the target number of turns (default: 6)

J.4.2 世代净化Post-Generation Decontamination

初始数据生成后，全面净化，确保数据不泄露：After initial data generation, comprehensive decontamination ensures no data leakage:

  1. 1.

    跨域过滤Cross-Domain Filtering:

    • •

      标识可以回答其他领域问题的文档Identifies documents that can answer questions from other domains

    • •

      移除受污染文档的样本Removes samples with contaminated documents

  2. 2.

    ClapNQ 净化ClapNQ Decontamination（每个域）：(per domain):

    • •

      每个域的检索器语料库是 ClapNQ 和 RAG 问题的真实文档块的组合，这确保两个集合中都没有出现文档。Retriever corpus for each domain is combinations of ClapNQ and ground truth document chunks for RAG question, this ensures no document appears in both sets.

    • •

      输出每个域的最终清理的 ClapNQ 文档Outputs final cleaned ClapNQ documents for each domain

  3. 3.

    域-ClapNQ 采样Domain-ClapNQ Sampling:

    • •

      对清理后的 ClapNQ 文档进行随机采样，使每个域的总数达到 20,000 个。Randomly samples cleaned ClapNQ documents to reach 20,000 total per domain.

    • •

      将每个域合并的 20k 文档集合保存为最终检索语料库。Saves merged 20k document collections per domain as final retrieval corpus.
